General-content county map showing towns (townships), rural buildings, and householders' names.

General-content county map showing towns (townships), rural buildings, and householders' names. Relief shown by hachures. Hand colored to emphasize town boundaries and areas. "Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1856 by Robert Pearsall Smith in the ... Eastern District of Pennsylvania." LC copy imperfect: Shellacked, mounted on cloth backing, pin-holed at corners, cloth-hemmed at outer edges, annotated "Greene N.Y." in gray wash on cloth backing. Includes 10 village insets (including Catskill), indexed local business directories, and illustrations of prominent buildings/bell.
